messages:
Ava (Marketing): Uploaded refined draft for the product launch post: https://docs.google.com/draft — need quick sign-offs on hero claim, benchmark framing, CTAs, and inbound routing. Can we close by EOD?

Priya (Product): skimmed. the '3x throughput' bullet should be hedged or cited. left a comment to soften to 'up to 3x in some workloads'. also suggest a one-liner quote from engineering.

Elliot (Design): hero comps ready. exporting two crop options and a mobile-first thumbnail. will add alt text suggestions once copy settles.

Sam (Growth): setting HubSpot UTMs and header CTA. recommended primary CTA -> webinar RSVP, secondary CTA -> demo. UTM template posted in doc.

Ben (Sales Ops): routing plan: Enterprise -> AE queue, Mid-market -> SDRs, Demo -> DemoOps. need exact lead_tier values to finalize tags.

Tom (CTO): quick quote: "We focused on predictable latency and unit cost so teams can ship LLM features without redesigning infra." Use as hero variant.

LegalBot: auto-scan flagged 'best-in-class latency' as a claim. please reword or add evidence.

Ava (Marketing): swapped 'best-in-class' for 'industry-grade' and linked the infra performance page. moved Tom's quote into hero options.

Sam (Growth): added RSVP button copy option: 'Save my seat' (preferred) and UTM for webinar: `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=mar2026_webinar`. added form field mapping for HubSpot.

Ben (Sales Ops): tags set in ops doc: `lead_tier: enterprise|midmarket|demo`. routing rules pushed to staging; will monitor first-hour traffic.

Elliot (Design): uploaded assets: hero_A.jpg, hero_B.jpg, mobile_thumb.jpg. left alt text lines in the doc.

Ava (Marketing): locking copy at 17:00 PT. scheduling to staging for preview. any last nits now.

LaunchBot: publish slot reserved 2026-03-12 13:00 UTC.

Sam (Growth): approved from growth. small tweak: move webinar blurb higher for SEO and conversion.

Priya (Product): added placeholder customer quote line — will replace with real later.

Ava (Marketing): final checklist: legal flagged terms addressed, hero quote in place, assets uploaded, UTMs and routing mapped. pushing to staging now.

LaunchBot: deploy scheduled: blog-staging -> production at 2026-03-12T13:00:00Z.

Ava (Marketing): pushed to staging. post-publish sync to review leads and conversion metrics.
